name: 70006 · Metairie, LA
findings: ZIP 70006 (Metairie) has 79 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70006 (Metairie) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 70006 (Metairie) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
